title: Add a discount to an estimate

steps.caption: Estimates
steps.narration: There are two ways to discount an estimate. Here are both.

steps.caption: Tick Draft
steps.narration: On Estimates, tick Draft to find one you have not sent yet.

steps.caption: Open the estimate
steps.narration: Open it.

steps.caption: Discounts
steps.narration: Under the total, choose Discounts.

steps.caption: Optional offers
steps.narration: These are optional offers. Each has a percent off, and a condition the client must meet.

steps.caption: Tick an offer
steps.narration: Tick the ones this client may choose on their estimate page.

steps.caption: Custom offer: label
steps.narration: You can also write your own. Give it a label,

steps.caption: Percent
steps.narration: a percent off,

steps.value: A neighbor books a job with us
steps.caption: Conditions
steps.narration: and what the client must do to qualify.

steps.caption: Add custom offer
steps.narration: Choose Add custom offer.

steps.caption: Save offers
steps.narration: Then choose Save offers.

steps.caption: Edit
steps.narration: For a fixed amount off, choose Edit.

steps.caption: Add line
steps.narration: Choose Add line.

steps.caption: Name the line
steps.narration: Name the line.

steps.caption: Kind: discount
steps.narration: Set Kind to discount.

steps.caption: The amount
steps.narration: Then type the amount.

steps.caption: Subtracted from the total
steps.narration: A discount line subtracts from the total.

steps.caption: Save changes
steps.narration: Choose Save changes.

steps.caption: The discount line
steps.narration: The estimate now has the discount as its own line, and a lower total.

steps.caption: Menu: Estimates
steps.narration: You'll find Estimates in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to add a discount to an estimate | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of discounts on an estimate in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will tick optional offers the client can choose, write a custom offer with its own percent and conditions, and add a fixed discount line that subtracts from the total.
